messages:
leni: morning, quick heads-up from the snapshot audit: noticed 4 snapshots in prod with SSE-KMS header pointing to an unexpected CMK (arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/alt-9999) rather than our standard backups CMK. possible policy drift?
omar: interesting. which snapshots?
leni: keys: backups/2026-03-24/tenant-21/snap-x.tar.gz, tenant-42/snap-y.tar.gz, tenant-56/snap-z.tar.gz, tenant-99/snap-w.tar.gz. timestamps around 2026-03-24T04:10.
trina: i checked key policy change log: someone added a cross-account principal mapping for a vendor testing key at 2026-03-24T03:50 and a later terraform apply merged by mistake referenced module var `backup_kms_key` set to alt-9999 in the workspace. looks like config drift between workspaces.
policy-bot: terraform apply detected: operator=ci-bot workspace=staging-ops -> prod-sync at 2026-03-24T03:52:11Z, changed variable backup_kms_key from arn:aws:kms:.../abcd to arn:aws:kms:.../alt-9999. plan link: https://git.internal/infra/plan/zzzz.
omar: that means uploads in that window used the wrong key. containment: can we revoke write access to alt-9999 or update bucket policy to require the approved CMK?
oncall-sre: immediate step: add bucket PutObject condition requiring x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id equals approved CMK arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef12. I can apply that as a temporary guard. will it block vendor flows? yes until we whitelist.
trina: also suggest reverting the terraform var in the prod workspace and adding a CI check that workspace-level vars cannot reference vendor keys.
security-bot: audit findings: 4 affected objects, no signs of GetObject by unfamiliar principals. flagged SEV-3 pending compliance review. recommended remediation: re-ingest from source with correct CMK if plaintext available, or re-upload from cached ingest.
leni: do we have cached plaintext for tenant-21 and tenant-42?
omar: tenant-21 cache expired, but tenant-42 and tenant-56 are within retention. for tenant-21 we need to contact application team to see if source exists.
trina: action items: 1) oncall-sre apply bucket CMK-equality guard (assigned) 2) infra revert var and open PR with workspace lock (trina) 3) omar to re-upload affected within retention and verify checksums (omar) 4) leni to start compliance ticket and draft tenant notifications if needed.
oncall-sre: applied temporary bucket condition at 2026-03-24T04:30:05Z denying PutObject unless SSE-KMS key id equals approved CMK. ticket INF-5702 opened.
omar: starting re-upload for tenant-42 and tenant-56 now. will post checksum results.
leni: thanks — keep the thread updated. once we confirm no external reads, compliance will decide on customer notification.
